title: Recursive Catalan Number
summary: Return the nth Catalan number using memoized recursive splits.
statement: Return the nth Catalan number using memoized recursive splits. Implement `recursive_catalan_number` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Every root choice splits the structure into independent left and right Catalan subproblems.
Memoize the recurrence that sums products across every split.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the recursive_catalan_number invariant is complete.
Editorial: Memoize the recurrence that sums products across every split. The intended bounds are O(n²) time and O(n) space.
